description: Internal Node.js module loader implementation for CommonJS modules, including module resolution, caching, and extension handling.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Represents a Node.js module, handles resolution, loading, and caching of modules.

methods.name: Module
methods.description: Constructor for Module objects, initializes module properties.

methods.name: readPackage
methods.description: Reads and caches package.json data for a given path.

methods.name: tryPackage
methods.description: Attempts to resolve a package's main file or index with extensions.

methods.name: tryFile
methods.description: Checks if a file exists and returns its real path if applicable.

methods.name: toRealPath
methods.description: Resolves the real path of a file, considering symlinks.

methods.name: tryExtensions
methods.description: Attempts to find a file with one of the registered extensions.

methods.name: findLongestRegisteredExtension
methods.description: Finds the longest extension registered in Module._extensions.

methods.name: trySelfParentPath
methods.description: Returns the filename of the parent module if available.

methods.name: trySelf
methods.description: Attempts to resolve module self-reference based on package exports.

methods.name: resolveExports
methods.description: Resolves package exports for scoped or unscoped modules.

methods.name: _findPath
methods.description: Finds the path to a module file given a request and search paths.

methods.name: _resolveLookupPaths
methods.description: Resolves lookup paths for a module request.

methods.name: Module._load
methods.description: Loads a module by request, handling cache, native modules, and resolution.

methods.name: _resolveFilename
methods.description: Resolves the filename for a module request, considering options and paths.

methods.name: _extensions['.js']
methods.description: Handles loading and parsing of JavaScript files.

methods.name: _extensions['.json']
methods.description: Handles loading and parsing of JSON files.

methods.name: _extensions['.node']
methods.description: Handles loading of native addon files.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a module's source code based on its filename.

methods.name: _compile
methods.description: Compiles and executes module source code in the correct scope.

methods.name: require
methods.description: Requires a module by id, returning its exports.

methods.name: createRequire
methods.description: Creates a require function for a given filename or URL.

methods.name: createRequireFromPath
methods.description: Creates a require function from a directory path.

methods.name: wrapSafe
methods.description: Wraps module code in a function and executes it safely.
